contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Learn and inspect executable model examples. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.
Enable a learner to inspect source/model/graph relationships through supported executable examples and the offline Craft learning workshop.
acceptance_conditions: The supported input, selected source/profile/tool and exact result scope are identified.

Existing packaged Rule/decision/API examples and the offline engineering game with model/bridge views, simulation controls and save/recovery. Scripted completion is not human learning-effectiveness evidence.
Unsupported, stale, unknown or out-of-scope results remain explicit; no inferred runtime or owner authority.
exclusions: Universal support or full lifecycle completion beyond the selected source path
Fresh runtime/provider/whole-product value qualification from this proposal
Implicit ownership transfer, admission, publication or deployment
